scope: Block-Insure policy, claim, oracle, adjudication, reserve, and payout state machines

properties.statement: Reserved coverage plus settled coverage never exceeds the snapshotted policy coverage limit.
The aggregate reserved-coverage counter equals the sum of open policy reservations represented by the test model.
Outstanding and unfunded liabilities equal allocated payouts minus funded or withdrawn amounts represented by the test model.
A payout is allocated and withdrawn at most once, and a failed recipient cannot corrupt shared accounting.
Oracle and manual decisions are bound to the active claim version; a completed version cannot be finalized again.
Approval requires three valid votes and rejection requires two invalid votes from the immutable four-auditor assignment.
Only the configured coordinator and adjudicator may invoke their respective manager finalization entry points.
A canonical provider invoice identity can enter at most one claim.
Administrative withdrawal cannot reduce the manager balance below approved liability, the configured capital buffer, and the exposure reserve.
A rejection may be appealed only within the configured appeal state machine and cannot erase the prior version decision.
